values.note: RV sites $45 a night, creekside $55; weekly $275 / $300; seasonal and monthly by phone. For 2 people, $5 per extra guest; rates include 30-amp electric, water and sewer. The page is dated 'Copyright 2025'.

values.note: 'RESERVATIONS WELCOME'; reservations by phone (828) 926-3353. Check-in noon to 5 PM only, checkout 11 AM. Seasonal campers may leave their units on site over the off season.

note: RV/pop-up park in central Maggie Valley on US 19 (Soco Rd), walkable to restaurants and shops; Campbell Creek runs along the property with creekside sites. Trailers and fifth wheels to 33 ft. No tents. Bring your own elevated fire pit. --Claude
